name: Cryogenic homogenization of gummy confectionery for analysis
description: Mechanical sample preparation for compositional analysis, distinct from observing ice crystals or removing water by sublimation.

sources.citation: RETSCH primary application: gummy bears inMM400/CryoKit

requirements.rationale: The sample requires mechanical cryogenic comminution; a static cold chamber cannot meet this capability merely by temperature.
The published application explicitly uses50mL steel jars.

missing_information: The source's observed final fineness is an application result, not a universal guaranteed capability.
The MM400 does not continuously maintain LN2 temperature; no constant -196 C sample claim is made.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
